description: Scale video clips so their frame fits the sequence frame (Clip > Video Options > Set to Frame Size), or fills it, by setting Motion > Scale without resampling. The source frame size comes from the project item's Video Info, or from sourceWidth and sourceHeight. Square pixels are assumed. One undo step

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

mode.description: fit: the whole frame shows (Set to Frame Size); fill: the sequence frame is covered, cropping the rest. Default fit

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

sourceHeight.description: Source frame height in pixels (give with sourceWidth)

sourceWidth.description: Source frame width in pixels, when the Video Info is missing (give with sourceHeight)

name: fit_clips_to_frame
title: Fit Clips To Frame
